summary: Closed the R007 privacy-contract gap. The closure-pack exporter now rejects representative forbidden private value classes even inside allowlisted token fields, the contract binds that fail-closed rule, the storage self-test covers email/phone/secret/nested bypasses, and the R007-equivalent harness now passes only when email and phone are rejected with FORBIDDEN_VALUE_CLASS. No destructive storage action or mandatory Supabase dependency was introduced.
